products.name: Hospital Twin — Simulated Hospital Environment for AI Solution Testing — Commercial
products.short_description: Design and build a hospital twin — a simulated hospital driven by synthetic data — where AI solutions are evaluated against scenarios safely before broader adoption. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Build a hospital twin to test AI safely before it reaches patients

Testing clinical AI in production is unacceptable — you need a place to try it first. This solution designs and builds a hospital twin: a simulated hospital environment, driven by synthetic clinical data and realistic operational dynamics, where AI solutions are evaluated against scenarios before broader adoption. It's the digital-twin harness that lets AI, QA, and architecture teams assess solutions safely and repeatably.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python tooling.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the hospital-twin concept: what it simulates (patients, encounters, workflows, events), how synthetic data drives it, and how AI solutions plug in for evaluation.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (synthetic data source, isolated environment, target AI use cases, scenario definitions, governance).
  • Build Guide — design the twin (entities, workflows, event dynamics), wire the synthetic data feed, define evaluation scenarios and AI plug-in points, run a pilot evaluation, and expand fidelity.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
  • Testing/validation gates (twin runs, scenarios execute, AI evaluated) plus Best Practices for iterative fidelity refinement.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A hospital twin where clinical AI is proven safe against realistic scenarios — before it ever touches a real patient — iteratively refined for higher fidelity.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • twin_fidelity_report.py — fidelity/behavior report for the hospital twin
    • twin_privacy_validate.py — privacy/disclosure-risk validation for the twin's synthetic feed
    • twin_readiness_assess.py — assess hospital-twin readiness and manage the scope/config record
    • twin_scenario_runner.py — scenario runner + AI plug-in harness for the hospital twin
    • twin_simulator.py — the hospital-twin/event simulator engine

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
